name: mycel
description: Open-core platform for non-profits: campaign sites, forms, donations, supporters and mailing. Framework-free domain core with HTTP, MCP and web adapters.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/api packages/mcp && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/web
scripts.build: tsc -b packages/api packages/mcp && npm run build --workspace apps/web
scripts.lint:infra: node --test docker/caddy/caddyfile.test.mjs scripts/adapter-fixtures.test.mjs scripts/db-refusals.test.mjs scripts/db-roles.test.mjs scripts/docs-links.test.mjs scripts/repo-size.test.mjs scripts/check-owner-strings.test.mjs scripts/release.test.mjs scripts/workflows.test.mjs scripts/drill-verify.test.mjs scripts/review-signals.test.mjs scripts/quality/*.test.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint:deps && npm run lint:infra && npm run typecheck && npm run test:collect && npm run test && npm run build && npm run test:e2e
scripts.docs:blocks: tsc -b packages/api packages/mcp && UPDATE_BLOCK_DOCS=1 vitest run apps/web/src/lib/editor/block-docs.test.ts
scripts.db:seed: tsc -b packages/db && npm run -s migrate -w @mycel/db && npm run -s seed -w @mycel/db
